limitations: This source review and synthetic controls do not authenticate production filesystem events or provider execution.
Successful hash/state-before-after checks are bounded observations, not continuous custody or defense against every concurrent adversarial filesystem race.
Opaque byte handling performs no semantic secret/label scan; approval remains typed custody with explicit limits.

static_evidence.finding: Production CLI only accepts the frozen custody, exact allowlist and reuse receipt hashes, fixed counts, canonical paths and required metadata fields. Exclusions are validated by path and not read.
Explicit descriptor traversal rejects symlink parents/files and nonregular types. Bytes and file identity/state are checked during each source read; paths are not discovered from content.

Every approved logical source is read and hashed independently, including existing archive aliases. Same-hash new content is byte-compared before deduplication. All ordered original tuples/roles remain in the mapping.

Raw destination must be a private 0700 directory. Archive creation is exclusive0600, followed by saved-byte checks and all-source/control checks. After-write failure leaves a private archive, not a success receipt.
Generated object member names and exact hash/size inventories are verified. Strict regular-file metadata, sorted membership and modes reject missing, extra, duplicate, link or path-traversal members.

Exceptions use static BoundaryError codes or exception class names; raw exception prose is not exported. Preserve action executes only fixed git check-ignore metadata verification. No provider or consumer execution exists.
Archive-only verification uses explicit archives, frozen control metadata and exact mappings; it does not reopen original mapped payload paths.

Operator-selected receipt output is resolved once, allowing conventional /tmp alias; raw source/archive traversal itself remains no-follow. This distinction prevents overclaiming that all operator path spellings are rejected when symlinked.
